name: hud_ui_background_load_from_zrd
description: HudUiBackground::LoadFromZrd loads a ZRD root from path, stores it as loadedRoot, then delegates section loading to HudUiBackground::LoadZrdAndSection.
known_limits: The smoke covers the missing-ZRD path and delegation into the accepted null-root LoadZrdAndSection behavior. Positive ZRD parsing is covered by zReader::LoadNodeFromPath and the accepted LoadZrdAndSection dependency.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudUiBackground source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b98d0 validates zReader::LoadNodeFromPath(zrdPath, 0, 0), loadedRoot assignment, and tail delegation to LoadZrdAndSection(root, sectionName, capturePrimary).
The native smoke verifies a missing ZRD path stores a null loadedRoot, delegates to clear cfgRoot, returns null, and completes the video postprocess/unlock frame through installed providers.
